components.name: 2.5D Pet Block
components.description: Tactile volumetric pet block with 6px extrusion lip and kawaii facial features.
components.css:
.ds-pet-block { position: relative; width: 48px; height: 54px; border-radius: 10px; background: #A82419; }
.ds-block-top { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FF6B5B 0%, #E84538 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.4); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

components.name: Relic Skill FAB
components.description: Circular 56dp action button triggering Hammer of Fire or Compass of Wind.
components.css:
.ds-relic-btn { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6D4226; border: 3px solid #9E633A; color: #fff; font-size: 24px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; }
.ds-relic-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.08); box-shadow: 0 0 16px #FF3D00; }

components.name: HUD Pill Badge
components.description: Trophy score or passenger counter pill badge.
components.css: .ds-hud-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #263238; border: 1.5px solid #455A64; color: #FFD84D; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; }

narrative.overview: Block Odyssey: Pet Express exists in a warm, miniature tactile world evoking a handcrafted wooden puzzle tray placed on the lush grass of a sunny public park. Every element communicates physical mass, polished edges, and tactile delight rather than flat digital minimalism.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Miniature Tactility: Thick beveled wooden board borders, recessed inner shadows, and chunky extrusion lips on every block.
Organic Character Vitality: 60fps procedural breathing, rhythmic blinking, and parabolic Bezier jumping arcs give life to inanimate blocks.
Zero-Asset Procedural Autonomy: 100% vector-drawn on Flutter Canvas without external raster sprite sheets.
Ergonomic Touch Clarity: Negative touch Y-offset (-70dp) guarantees the player's dragging thumb never obscures block geometry.

rules.name: The Volumetric Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every pet block and toy bus MUST render a bottom extrusion lip shifted 6px vertically in its assigned dark tonal shade (darkColor). Flat un-extruded shapes are strictly forbidden on the game board.

rules.name: The Silhouette Redundancy Rule
rules.body: Colors must never be the sole differentiator of pet species. Every pet block must carry a distinctive vector silhouette to guarantee universal colorblind accessibility.

rules.name: The Floating Value Rule
rules.body: Floating score popups (+150, FEVER!) MUST render with a 2px dark stroke (#263238) or heavy blur shadow to preserve legibility over diverse board colors during rapid combos.

dos: Do maintain the 6px extrusion lip on every placed and dragging block to preserve the 2.5D toy diorama aesthetic.
Do apply touchOffsetY = -70.0dp during block drag operations to prevent touch occlusion.
Do draw facial silhouettes distinctly so colorblind players can identify pet types without relying on color.
Do execute passenger extraction and boarding via smooth parabolic Bezier curves with pentatonic chime SFX.
Do keep all interactive buttons at >= 48x48dp touch target sizes on mobile.
donts: Don't introduce flat unshaded single-color vectors into the game board.
Don't use external raster bitmap assets (.png, .jpg) for blocks or buses; all assets must be procedurally generated via Canvas.
Don't allow board cells or HUD text to overflow on compact mobile viewports (minimum target 360x780dp).
Don't interrupt the 7-step ActionQueue execution sequence while blocks are placing or lines are clearing.
